content.rendered:
The Hawks View office will reopen on August 19th, 7:30 to 3:30, with the exception of Wednesday, August 21st. On Wednesday morning the office will be closed 9:30-11:30.

Supply lists for the 2024-25 school year can be found below:

2024-2025 Hawks View Supply List

2024-2025 Hawks View Supply List-Spanish
